sub_graphs.title: Altair BLS: Public Key Aggregation Pipeline
sub_graphs.description: Models the public key aggregation process including input validation for sync committee and other aggregate operations

nodes.label: Public Key Set Received
nodes.description: A sequence of BLS public keys has been received for aggregation

nodes.label: Check Public Key Set Non-Empty
nodes.description: Assert that the input public key sequence is not empty before aggregation

nodes.label: Validate Each Public Key
nodes.description: Call bls.KeyValidate() on each public key to ensure it is a valid group element

nodes.label: All Public Keys Valid
nodes.description: All input keys passed KeyValidate, ready for aggregation

nodes.label: Aggregate Public Key Points
nodes.description: Iteratively add public key elliptic curve points to produce a single aggregate public key

nodes.label: Aggregate Public Key Produced
nodes.description: Single aggregate public key available for use in signature verification

external_entities.name: Public Key Source
external_entities.description: Beacon state or sync committee providing public keys for aggregation

sub_graphs.title: Altair BLS: Fast Aggregate Signature Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the fast aggregate verify function including the special empty-set edge case handling

nodes.label: Aggregate Verification Requested
nodes.description: A request to verify an aggregate signature against a set of public keys and a message

nodes.label: Check for Empty Public Key Set
nodes.description: Determine if the public key sequence is empty (no signers)

nodes.label: Check Signature is Point at Infinity
nodes.description: If pubkey set is empty, verify that signature equals G2_POINT_AT_INFINITY (0xc0 followed by 95 zero bytes)

nodes.label: Empty Set Verification Passed
nodes.description: Empty pubkey set with point-at-infinity signature returns True

nodes.label: Delegate to BLS FastAggregateVerify
nodes.description: Call bls.FastAggregateVerify(pubkeys, message, signature) for the standard non-empty case

nodes.label: Aggregate Signature Invalid
nodes.description: Verification failed - signature does not match pubkeys and message

edges.label: Signature is not point at infinity

external_entities.name: Signature Source
external_entities.description: Component providing the aggregate signature, public keys, and message for verification (e.g., sync committee processing)

ambiguities.text: The specification states it is 'for demonstrative purposes only and ignores encoding/decoding concerns', making it unclear whether the exact byte representation of G2_POINT_AT_INFINITY is normative.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume G2_POINT_AT_INFINITY = 0xc0 followed by 95 zero bytes is the normative compressed representation per the BLS draft standard. Implementations must use this exact encoding.

ambiguities.text: The behavior when KeyValidate fails for one key in eth_aggregate_pubkeys is not explicitly specified (abort vs skip).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the function aborts and returns an error if any key fails KeyValidate, as the assertion pattern implies all keys must be valid.

implicit_assumptions.description: The BLS library implementation (bls.KeyValidate, bls.FastAggregateVerify) is assumed to be correct and conform to the IETF BLS signature draft standard v4.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A buggy BLS library could accept invalid signatures, allowing forged attestations, sync committee messages, or other signed consensus data.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot find collisions in the BLS aggregate signature scheme or forge aggregate signatures without controlling the corresponding private keys.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Rogue key attacks or aggregate forgery could allow an attacker to impersonate groups of validators, breaking consensus safety.
